title: Owl eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- owl body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='30' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='16' ry='20' fill='#D2A679'/>
  <!-- feather texture on belly -->
  <path d='M42 60 Q50 65 58 60' stroke='#B8865A' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M42 68 Q50 73 58 68' stroke='#B8865A' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='22' fill='#A06A3E'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <polygon points='32,16 38,28 26,26' fill='#6B4226'/>
  <polygon points='68,16 62,28 74,26' fill='#6B4226'/>
  <!-- face disc left -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='32' r='12' fill='#F5DEB3'/>
  <!-- face disc right -->
  <circle cx='59' cy='32' r='12' fill='#F5DEB3'/>
  <!-- left eye -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='31' r='6' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='31' r='3' fill='#2B1B4A'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='29.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <circle cx='59' cy='31' r='6' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='31' r='3' fill='#2B1B4A'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='29.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='47,38 53,38 50,46' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <!-- snack: mouse held in talons -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='78' r='4' fill='#C07040'/>
  <!-- mouse ears -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='75' r='2.5' fill='#E8A0A0'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='75' r='2.5' fill='#E8A0A0'/>
  <!-- mouse eye -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='77' r='1' fill='#2B1B4A'/>
  <!-- mouse tail -->
  <path d='M58 78 Q64 74 62 68' stroke='#C07040' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='58' rx='8' ry='18' fill='#7A4E2D'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='58' rx='8' ry='18' fill='#7A4E2D'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M44 88 L42 94 M44 88 L46 94 M44 88 L44 95' stroke='#FF8C00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 88 L54 94 M56 88 L58 94 M56 88 L56 95' stroke='#FF8C00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
